summary: Retest of v1.0.5 fixes: (1) Electron harness re-run with Xvfb :99 → HARNESS_SHIM {shim:true, alertNative:false, confirmNative:false, promptSafe:true, isDesktop:true} + HARNESS_PASS (typedAfterDialogs='abc', activeTag=INPUT). (2) grep of /app/frontend/src → zero remaining native prompt( calls (only doc comments in PromptDialog.jsx). (3) BOM page Revise → in-app PromptDialog (data-testid=prompt-dialog) opens pre-filled with next revision 'B'; Cancel closes with no API call and body pointer-events:auto; OK fired POST /api/bom/{id}/revise?new_revision=B. (4) Settings → Integrations → 'Test Lookup' (GSTIN verify) opens in-app PromptDialog; Cancel closes cleanly. (5) PDF preview (BOM → PDF): dialog renders, only ONE visible X in toolbar (2nd lucide-x is the Radix button hidden via [&>button:last-child]:hidden), [data-testid=pdf-preview-close] clicked with normal (non-forced) click, dialog closed, body pointer-events:auto, typing in BOM search worked after close. (6) Items regression: Add Item dialog typing works (value 'TESTX'), Esc closes, body pointer-events:auto, search box typing works ('bolt').
critical_code_review_comments: Settings GSTIN verify control is labelled 'Test Lookup' (not 'Verify') and lacks a data-testid; add one (e.g. settings-gstin-test-lookup) for stable automation.

rca_of_the_issue: Previously native window.prompt() (unsupported in Electron) threw and Radix's default close button overlapped the custom close button. Fixes verified: promptDialog() replaces native prompt, main.js shim returns null for window.prompt, and DialogContent hides the last-child Radix close button.
